blocks.text: Collaborative whiteboard for visual thinking and team alignment

Miro gives distributed teams the shared visual space they lose by not being in the same room. The infinite canvas supports everything from quick brainstorms to detailed system architecture diagrams, making abstract ideas tangible and collaborative.

For product and design teams, Miro bridges the gap between ideation and execution. Start with sticky notes and rough sketches, evolve into user journey maps and wireframes, then hand off structured output to your project management tool. The thinking process stays visual and collaborative throughout.

Miro's template library covers lean canvases, sprint retrospectives, customer journey maps, and technical diagrams - giving teams a structured starting point for common activities instead of a blank canvas.
Unlimited space for brainstorming, diagramming, and visual planning
Multiple users working on the same board with cursors, comments, and reactions
Pre-built frameworks for lean canvas, retros, journey maps, and more
Flowcharts, org charts, mind maps, and technical diagrams
Ideation tools with timer, voting, and clustering features
Embed Figma designs, Jira tickets, Google Docs, and more
Miro is invaluable during the discovery phase of automation projects. Mapping out existing workflows visually before building helps teams identify bottlenecks and design better solutions.
Our team can integrate Miro into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
